adjudication.rationale: The handler gates all logic behind `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return 403` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:11-16). In this diff, `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), which is falsy when `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset or set to an empty string. Therefore the code will not reach the header/secret comparison in the scenario described (unset secret + missing header yielding `undefined === undefined`).
